quests.title: Where's Nub?

steps.objText: Look for small tracks by the stone
steps.journal: Burl's cub Nub is lost. Find tracks.

steps.objText: Follow the tracks to the tower door
steps.journal: Small tracks lead to the tower door.

steps.objText: Follow the wet prints down the road
steps.journal: No Nub, only wet prints. Follow them.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl where the tracks went

offer: Have you seen my Nub? Small. Round. Never listens.
He was by the waystone at sunup. Then he wasn't.
Take this. A hunter left it on my slope, long ago.
A bow sees further than a bear. Find his tracks.
active: Small tracks, sky-cub. Smaller than mine. Follow them.
ready: Down the road west? All that way, on those legs.
...Smell that? Wet cub. He came home behind you.
He followed your tracks while you followed his.
For your trouble. It was in his mouth. Still warm.
done: Nub sleeps. Sleeps! First time in three days.

quests.title: The North Boars

steps.objText: Drive off the three north boars
steps.journal: North woods: drive off three boars.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the north is quiet

offer: More boars, sky-cub. Three, up by the north trees.
They smelled the empty slope and came back for it.
active: Three. North trees. Listen for the chewing.
ready: Quiet up north. I can hear the bees again.
Here. Red, and bitter. It mends what tusks tear.
done: North is quiet. West, though. Hear that?

quests.title: The West Boars

steps.objText: Drive off the two west boars
steps.journal: Drive two boars off the west side.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the west is quiet

offer: Two more, down the west side. Young ones, loud.
Young is not slow. Mind your feet.
active: Two, west side. Loud. You won't miss them.
ready: West is quiet. Only two, and so much noise.
Sticks with feathers. Hunters lose them everywhere.
done: West is quiet. The south slope still grunts.

quests.title: The South Boars

steps.objText: Drive off the three south boars
steps.journal: South woods: drive off three boars.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the south is quiet

offer: Last of them. Three, on the south slope, by the rocks.
The big one leads. Don't let him get behind you.
active: South slope, by the rocks. Mind the big one.
ready: All of them! The whole slope is mine again.
A walker left this by the rocks. It fits you better.
done: No boars. Just bees, and berries, and a sky-cub.

steps.objText: Bring Burl a piece of boar meat
steps.journal: Winter nears. Bring Burl boar meat.

offer: Berries are summer food. Winter wants fat.
Those boars owe me. Bring me a haunch, sky-cub.
active: A haunch. Boar. You know where they grunt.
ready: Mm. Still warm. The boars pay their rent at last.
Trade you. It's bitter, but it mends.
done: One haunch. Winter is long, sky-cub. But it's a start.

steps.objText: Put your hand on the waystone
steps.journal: Touch the humming waystone.

steps.objText: Read the knot at its foot
steps.journal: Read the knot at the stone.

offer: The stone hums at night now. And I smell old rope there.
Put a hand on it. Look at its foot. Tell me.
active: The stone, then the foot of it. Rope, I think.
ready: A trimmer's knot. Old. Someone sat by that stone once.
Hm. The stone hums back. Take this, sky-cub.
done: The stone hums. I hum back. Nobody minds.

steps.objText: Read the claw marks at the door
steps.journal: Something claws at the tower door.

steps.objText: Drive off the two foxes
steps.journal: Foxes burst out of the tower.

steps.objText: Pick up what they dragged out
steps.journal: Take what the foxes dragged out.

offer: Something claws at the tower door at night.
My cub sleeps near it. Read the marks?
active: The tower door. Read the marks, then be ready.
ready: Foxes. Rude, but small.
That lamp hood is off your ship. Take these.
done: Quiet nights at the tower now. Thank you.

steps.objText: Walk down to the river bank
steps.journal: Is the river safe? Walk to the bank.

steps.objText: Find the stones at the ford
steps.journal: Find the stones to cross the river.

offer: West, past the bend, there's a river. Loud water.
I haven't seen it since I was a cub. Is it still there?
active: The river. West. You'll hear it before you see it.
ready: Still there. Still loud. Good. Some things should stay.
Someone left this on my slope once. It fits a walker.
done: Loud water, stones to cross. Don't fall in, sky-cub.

quests.title: Word from the Crossroads

steps.objText: Read the note post at the crossroads
steps.journal: Read the crossroads post for Burl.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl what the post says

offer: Birds say there's a post at the crossroads. With paper.
I can't read, sky-cub. Go and read it for me?
active: The post at the crossroads. Read it, then tell me.
ready: Straw men, and arrows? Someone out there practises.
Practising means staying. Here, sky-cub. A red one.
done: Someone at the crossroads. I hope they like berries.

quests.title: Walk Burl to the Bend

steps.objText: Walk with Burl to the Bend Waystone
steps.journal: Walk with Burl to the Bend Waystone.

quests.returnText: Talk to Burl at the Bend Waystone

offer: The bend stone blinks now, you say. I want to see it.
Old legs. Walk slow with me?
active: Slow, sky-cub. Bears don't hurry. Bears arrive.
ready: There. Blink, blink, blink. Like it's calling someone.
Thank you for the slow walk. Sticks, for your bow.
done: I'll sit here a while. Then the long way home.

quests.title: Meat for the Basket

steps.objText: Bring the meat to the post-keeper
steps.journal: Two cuts of meat for the post-keeper.

quests.returnText: Give the meat to the post-keeper

offer: There's a basket on a post, by the crossroads.
Whoever fills it feeds whoever comes. Take this meat.
Two haunches. I have more than one bear needs.
active: Two haunches, in the basket. Don't eat them on the way.
ready: Boar meat, from Burl? She always sends too much.
In the basket it goes. Arrows for you. Basket's rule.
done: Fed someone, did we? Good. The slope can spare it.

quests.title: Leave What You Can Spare

steps.objText: Take 3 arrows to the post-keeper
steps.journal: Spare the post-keeper three arrows.

quests.returnText: Give the arrows to the post-keeper

offer: The basket runs low. Arrows go first, always.
Spare me three? Others walk this road too.
active: Three arrows, when you can spare them.
ready: Three. Someone will need these. Thank you.
Here. A health potion. The basket gives back.
done: Leave what you can spare. You did.

quests.title: Three Straw Men

objectives.journal: Shoot the first of three straw men.
One hit. Now shoot the second.
Two down. Shoot the third straw man.

quests.returnText: Tell Rook the straw men are down

offer: Three straw men stand by the notice post.
Hit all three, then tell Rook the crow?
active: Three straw men. Three hits. The bundle waits.
ready: Three hits. I counted. Crows always count.
Twenty sticks from the bundle. Feathered. Yours.
done: A new line on the tally. Yours, this time.

steps.objText: Wear the buckler to the ford
steps.journal: Wear the buckler to the ford for Joss.

offer: Someone left this buckler by the stone. No name.
Wear it down to the ford and back. Then show me.
active: Buckler on your arm. Down to the ford, then back.
ready: Fits you. Nobody came back for it.
Keep it. And a health potion, for the knocks.
done: Left for the next walker. That was you.
accept: Strap it tight. The ford road bites.
decline: It'll keep. Nobody else came for it.

quests.title: Word for Burl

steps.objText: Tell Burl the road is clear
steps.journal: Road is clear, says Joss. Tell Burl.

quests.returnText: Report to Joss at the Bend Waystone

offer: Tell Burl, up on the tower hill: the road's clear.
She asks after my road. Every season.
active: Burl. Tower hill. The road's clear. That's all.
ready: She heard? Good. She worries, for a bear.
Five arrows. Straight ones.
done: Road's clear, and the bear knows. Quiet day.
accept: Up the hill. Say it plain. Bears like plain.
decline: She'll wait. Bears are good at waiting.

quests.title: Down the Road West

steps.objText: Walk back along the road
steps.journal: Walk back along the west road.

steps.objText: Come back to the Bend Waystone
steps.journal: Now return to the Bend Waystone.

quests.returnText: Report to Joss at the Bend Waystone

offer: Walk the road back toward your tower, would you?
Then come back here to the stone. Tell me what moves.
active: Back along the road. Then here, to the stone.
ready: Nothing moving? Good. Nothing is good news.
Five arrows. Fair, for a walk.
done: Road walked. I'll sleep easier.
accept: Watch the verges. Things hide in the long grass.
decline: Road's not going anywhere. Neither am I.

quests.title: Wet Boots

objectives.journal: Wade across to the west bank.
A boot crate sank by the ford stones.

quests.returnText: Tell the post-keeper about the boots

offer: A boot-maker lost a crate in the ford, last spring.
Those boots never slip on wet stone. Fetch them?
active: West bank, below the stones. A turtle sits there.
ready: River Boots. Sure on wet stone. Keep them.
Ten arrows too. For the turtle bites.
done: Good boots. They never slip. Mind the moss.

steps.objText: Climb the north lookout
steps.journal: Smoke rises north. Climb the lookout.

offer: There's a lookout north of the ford. High rocks.
Climb it. Look north. Tell me what you see.
active: The lookout, north of the ford. Climb. Look.
ready: Smoke, you say? Cookfires, or trouble.
Ten arrows. Either way, you'll want them.
done: North's watched. Somebody had to.

steps.objText: Walk to the west crossroads
steps.journal: Walk the west road to the crossroads.

offer: Past the ford, the west road meets a crossroads.
Walk out to it. Tell me which ways still go.
active: The west road. Out to the crossroads.
ready: All still go? Good. Roads forget slowly.
A health potion. Roads are long.
done: Every road goes somewhere. Most go west.

steps.objText: Look at the gap in the meadow fence
steps.journal: Check the meadow fence gap for Burl.

offer: Someone opened the old gate on the meadow side.
Boars don't unlatch. Go and look, sky-cub.
active: The meadow fence. Where the posts lean. Go look.
ready: A gap and a leaning rail? Rot, not paws. Good.
Here. I found these in the roots. You use them.
done: Rot, not paws. I can sleep on that.

quests.title: The Woodcutter's Corner

steps.objText: Check the woodcutter's stack
steps.journal: Check the woodcutter's stack for Burl.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl the stack is dry

offer: There's a woodcutter's stack by my clearing.
Nobody cuts here. Who stacked it? Go and sniff.
active: The stack, north of my clearing. Look closely.
ready: Dry, and old. Left by a walker, then. Like you.
Trade you a red draught for the news.
done: An old stack, warm in the sun. I sit by it now.

objectives.journal: Search the tipped cart by the road.
Robbers hide in the verge grass.
Open the strongbox under the cart.

offer: I smell honey and fear on a cart, down the road.
Someone left in a hurry. Search it for me?
active: The tipped cart, west on the road. Watch the grass.
ready: Robbers, and a strongbox. Honey, too!
Ten arrows for you. The comb is mine.
done: A tipped cart. Many left in a hurry, that year.

quests.title: Lamps on the Verge

steps.objText: Walk along the lamps by the road
steps.journal: Walk the old lamps along the road.

quests.returnText: Report to Joss at the Bend Waystone

offer: Old lamps stand along the road. Dark, mostly.
Walk the line of them. See if any still burn.
active: The lamps by the road. Walk the whole line.
ready: All dark? Thought so. Someone trimmed them, once.
A health potion, for the walk.
done: Dark lamps. I'll get to them. One day.
accept: All of them, mind. Not just the near ones.
decline: They've been dark a while. Another day won't hurt.

quests.title: Rocks at the Forest Edge

steps.objText: Check the rocks by the forest edge
steps.journal: Check the rock piles at forest edge.

quests.returnText: Report to Joss at the Bend Waystone

offer: Rocks piled at the forest edge. Too neat for chance.
Not mine. I stack gravel, not cairns. Go and look.
active: The rocks at the forest edge. Look close.
ready: Stacked, like a cairn? Old way-marks, then.
Five arrows. Mind the edge after dark.
done: Way-marks. Someone walked this road before us.
accept: Look, don't move them. Old things mind being moved.
decline: They've stood this long. They'll stand a bit more.

steps.objText: Bring the brass scrap to Joss
steps.journal: Brass scrap to Joss at Bend Waystone.

offer: My mallet head works loose. Brass would hold it.
Bring me a brass scrap. Your ship dropped plenty.
active: One brass scrap. From your wreck, or anywhere.
ready: Good brass. That'll hold the head on.
Ten arrows. Brass is worth that, out here.
done: Mallet's tight. Listen. Hear it ring?
accept: Any scrap. Flat is better. Bent will do.
decline: I'll tie it with string again. It's held so far.

steps.objText: Look at the wallow south of the road
steps.journal: Check the wallow south of the road.

offer: Boars. At the wallow, south of the Bend road.
They dug up my hides. I counted. They are short.
Go and look. Tell me how many holes.
active: The wallow. South. Count the holes for me.
ready: Eleven holes, and one very fat boar. Ha.
Mine, the hides, but you may have this. Found it.
done: Eleven. I will never get them all back.

steps.objText: Go to the river farm gate
steps.journal: Find out who lived at the farm.

steps.objText: Defeat the 3 goblins
steps.journal: Goblins hold the farm. Drive them off.

steps.objText: Read the note on the crate
steps.journal: Read the note at the farm.

offer: A farm by the river. I smelled bread there once.
Who lived there? Go and see. I need to know.
active: The river farm, south of the road. Go in.
ready: Gone to the Outwall. Back by spring. Alive!
Take this, sky-cub. You earned it.
done: Alive, and gone to the Outwall. I can wait.

quests.title: Where the Bees Go

steps.objText: Follow the bees to the old bee farm
steps.journal: Follow the bees from Burl's slope.

quests.returnText: Tell Burl where the bees go

offer: My bees fly south at noon and come back sticky.
Follow them, sky-cub. Walk. Don't swat.
active: South-east, past the meadow. Follow the hum.
ready: A bee farm! Old boxes, and honey still in them.
Good. I won't tell the crow. Take these.
done: The bees know a farm I don't. Fair enough.

steps.objText: Walk to the ring of standing stones
steps.journal: Find the ring of standing stones.

offer: Past the bees, there is a ring of stones. Old ones.
Cut with the same letters as the humming stone.
Go and see. Take your paw, hand, whichever.
active: The ring of stones. Past the bee farm.
ready: Cut like the waystone. So it is a long road, this.
Two red draughts. Mind the hills on the way home.
done: The same letters. The same hum, I think.

quests.title: Boars in the Stores

steps.objText: Drive off the two boars at the post
steps.journal: Drive two boars from the post stores.

quests.returnText: Tell the post-keeper the boars fled

offer: Two boars broke into my stores. Right there.
Drive them off before they eat the winter.
active: The two boars, in my stores. Go on.
ready: Gone, and only one sack torn. Good.
Take something off the shelf. You earned it.
done: Stores whole. Boars elsewhere. Good.

steps.objText: Pick five red caps on tree trunks
steps.journal: Pick five red caps from tree trunks.

offer: Red caps. Shelf fungus on trunks, up the road.
Five. I like red. A crow may like what it likes.
active: Five red caps. On the trunks. Up the road.
ready: Five. Not one eaten. You are better than a crow.
Take these. I made them. Yes, I did.
done: Red. Shiny. Mine. Thank you, fell-bird.

steps.objText: Go to the well north of the post
steps.journal: Cold air comes out of the old well.

steps.objText: Look down into the well
steps.journal: Look down the cold well.

offer: Cold air comes up out of that old well.
I will not go near it. You look. Tell me.
active: The well, north of the trade post. Look down it.
ready: It gave you something, did it? Keep it close.
Here, a Mana Potion. Not for me. For you.
done: Cold well. Warm hands. Good hands, mind.

quests.title: The Fallen Shrine

steps.objText: Look at the fallen shrine
steps.journal: Fallen shrine by the note post. Look.

quests.returnText: Tell the post-keeper which way it fell

offer: A shrine lies fallen by the notice post.
Go and look. Tell me which way it fell.
active: The fallen shrine, by the notice post.
ready: West? It fell west. Of course it did.
Ten arrows. Odd thing to ask, I know.
done: Always west, out here. Even the stones.

objectives.text: Walk out on the old jetty
objectives.journal: Walk out on the old jetty, carefully.
A brass cog lies at the jetty end.
A reed eel strikes from the water.

offer: A brass cog washed onto the old jetty. Joss needs one.
Walk out on the planks, slowly. Bring it back.
active: The jetty end. Step light. Something lurks below.
ready: You got the cog, and the eel let go. Good.
Ten arrows. Joss will be glad of it.
done: Half a jetty. A whole cog. Fair trade.

steps.objText: Bring the cog to Joss
steps.journal: Brass cog to Joss at Bend Waystone.

offer: The waystone's mount is short one cog. I hear it.
Bring me a brass cog. I'll fit it myself.
active: One brass cog. You'll have one somewhere.
ready: That'll do. It'll turn smooth now.
Ten arrows. Fair trade.
done: You won't see the cog turn. I will.
accept: Brass, toothed, about so big. You'll know it.
decline: It'll grind a while longer. I'll hear it.

quests.title: Ask the Bear

steps.objText: Ask Burl if bears eat crows
steps.journal: Ask Burl: do bears eat crows?

quests.returnText: Tell Rook what the bear said

offer: I have a question for the bear. I won't ask it myself.
Ask her: do bears eat crows? Say it plain.
active: The question for the bear. Plain. Not mine.
ready: Only on feast days? Hm. Is today a feast day?
Never mind. A red draught. I stole it, fairly.
done: I will stay on the high branch. Thank you.

steps.objText: Give the brass scrap to Burl
steps.journal: Give Burl the brass scrap from Rook.

offer: A scrap of brass. My second best. Take it to the bear.
Say it is from the crow. Say nothing else.
active: The brass. To the bear. Say nothing else.
ready: A crow gives me brass? Oh. Put it by my bed, sky-cub.
Tell him: not on feast days. Not ever. Here.
done: The brass shines by my bed. Tell the crow so.

steps.objText: Find hide for a strap
steps.journal: Find hide to strap the gondola plate.

offer: A bent plate hangs off the wreck. Shield-sized.
Bring boar hide to Burl so she can strap it?
active: A plate and a strap. Boar hide would do.
done: The wreck creaks. The plate is yours now.

steps.objText: Bring Burl's honeycomb to Rook
steps.journal: Bring Burl's honeycomb to Rook.

offer: That crow on the old stone. Loud thing.
Take it this comb. Tell it we're square.
active: The comb is for the crow. Do not lick it.
ready: Sticky. From the bear? Hm. Square, then.
Sticks with feathers. Hunters lose them.
And this. On a branch. Fits a fell-bird.
done: Square with the crow. Good. I hate owing.

steps.objText: Find four brass scraps
steps.journal: Bring Rook four shiny brass scraps.

offer: Your sky-boat dropped shinies. Everywhere.
Four brass bits. Bring them. I trade fair.
active: Four brass bits. Your sky-boat sheds them.
ready: One, two, three, four. Good count.
Arrows, and red drink. Not shiny. Useful.
done: Shiny things. I keep them. You keep the arrows.

quests.title: The Oilcloth Packet

steps.objText: Bring the packet to the post-keeper
steps.journal: Oilcloth packet to the post-keeper.

quests.returnText: Hand the packet to the post-keeper

offer: An oilcloth packet, stitched: FOR THE FORD POST.
Carry it to the post-keeper by the crossroads?
active: The packet. The ford post, by the crossroads.
ready: FOR THE FORD POST. That's here. Long road for it.
Not my hand on it. Older. I'll keep it safe.
Twenty arrows. It waited longer than you did.
done: The basket waits. The tags turn in the wind.

steps.objText: Find three emberpods in Cinder Hollow
steps.journal: Get three emberpods in Cinder Hollow.

offer: Salt in my larder, sky-cub. Now a thing for you.
Down in Cinder Hollow, red pods grow in the ash.
Bring me three. Warm ones. I'll show you fire.
active: Three pods, sky-cub. Red, and warm to the paw.
Cinder Hollow. Follow the smell of old smoke.
ready: Warm still. Good. Now watch, and don't blink.
She cracks a pod between two claws. A coal glows.
She breathes on it. It leaps and bursts on a stump.
That's fire, sky-cub. Close your fist on it. Throw.
It's for teeth and tusks. Not for bushes. Not mine.
Take this, for when your fire runs low.
done: Feed your fire slow, sky-cub. It's always hungry.
